title: Test script
what: A Python script beside the document runs the design on known cases and prints `N failing`.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Any command
what: Any command; it prints `N failing` (or say `count_re` / `fail_re`), or its exit code decides.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`, or else exits 0; exit 3 = did not build

title: Timing script
what: A Python script beside the document runs the design and prints `time_ms=...`.

title: Any command
what: Any command; it prints `name=value` for each metric it measures, listed as the stage's `metrics`.

title: Accuracy against a reference
what: Calls the design's function and a reference on the same cases and reports how far apart they are: absolute, relative and ULP error.

title: The spec's AVS tests pass
what: Runs a PTO-style spec unit's AVS tests with ASLRef, through the spec's own runner, from the spec kept in the application's folder. Each failing test a line, then the count.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Time a Python function
what: Loads the design, calls one function with your arguments, times it over several runs.

title: Compare with a reference function
what: Calls the design's function on cases (a JSON table, the reference's CASES, random inputs from its inputs(rng)) and compares each result with the reference function's or the expected value.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Compare a C function with a reference
what: Builds the design as a shared library and calls one function (a scalar signature) on cases, each result compared with a Python reference function's or the expected value.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Build the prefetcher into ChampSim
what: Compiles a prefetcher header into ChampSim; reports the first compiler error.
pass: passes when it builds; exit 3 = did not build

title: Smoke-run the prefetcher
what: Builds the prefetcher and runs it on one trace; refused when it issues no prefetches.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Simulate on your traces (ChampSim)
what: Runs an .ini or a prefetcher header on every trace; the geometric-mean IPC speed-up over no prefetcher.

title: Why the prefetcher wins (ChampSim)
what: Runs it and the run without it on every trace: L2 misses per kilo-instruction with and without it, the share of misses it removed (coverage), and how many of its prefetches were used, late or useless.

title: Source complexity
what: Reads the design's source (any common language) and counts its lines of code, functions, cyclomatic complexity and tokens; nothing is built or run.

title: No function too complex
what: Fails each function whose cyclomatic complexity is over the limit.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Metrics from formulas
what: Runs any measurement and adds metrics computed from its numbers, such as area times delay or throughput per watt.

title: Numbers out of any tool's output
what: Runs your tool and reads its JSON, CSV or text output, printing the numbers you pick as name=value.

title: Test against a golden model
what: Verilator runs the module on golden.py's vectors and counts the wrong outputs.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

lib.label: Other HDL read beside the design, in place: a .sv/.v file, a folder (its .sv and .v) or a .f filelist, e.g. --lib {home}/ip; a design that redefines one of its modules is refused (exit 3)

title: Every MUST clause covered and passing
what: Reads a PTO-style spec unit's NDF clauses (the NDF tool, from the spec in the application's folder) and the AVS results `fluxpreset asl run --out` wrote: each MUST clause that failed or has no test is a line, then the count.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Program size
what: Builds the program and reads its sections with `size`: text, data and bss bytes.

title: Program run time
what: Builds the program and times it over several runs (hyperfine when present).

title: Instruction count (Valgrind)
what: Builds the program and counts instructions and cache misses with Valgrind's cachegrind: deterministic.

title: Program peak memory
what: Builds the program and runs it: its peak resident memory as the kernel counts it, the most over the runs.

title: The design matches the spec's ASL model
what: Builds a pyCircuit design (pycircuit, the C++ model) and drives it with each unit's reference vectors -- the spec's own answers from ASLRef, cached per spec -- one wrong vector a line, then the count. The interface: `fluxpreset pto ops`.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Run your pytest file
what: Runs your pytest file with the design importable as `design`; counts the failing tests.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: No worse than a baseline
what: Runs any measurement again and fails when a metric is worse than the recorded baseline by more than the tolerance.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: Median of several runs
what: Runs any measurement several times and prints each metric's median and its spread, so one noisy run does not decide.

title: Lint for hardware defects
what: Verilator's hardware defects only: latches, multiple drivers, combinational loops, blocking/non-blocking mixes, implicit nets; width and style warnings are not defects. It also refuses what does not parse.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not parse or did not run

title: Memory and undefined-behaviour errors
what: Builds the program with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer and runs it: each memory error, leak or undefined behaviour it hits is a failure.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: How time grows with size
what: Times the program at doubling problem sizes and fits time ~ n^k: the exponent says how it scales (1 linear, 2 quadratic), the constant factor aside.

title: Scales no worse than n^k
what: Times the program at doubling sizes and fails when time grows faster than n to the given power.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build

title: SystemC translates to RTL (ICSC)
what: ICSC translates the SystemC module to SystemVerilog: passes when it does, and when the ports are the golden model's.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not translate

title: SystemC against a golden model
what: ICSC translates the SystemC module, then Verilator runs the RTL on golden.py's vectors.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not translate

title: Within a time budget
what: Times one call of the design's function on a large input and fails a design slower than the budget, before the costly benchmark.
pass: passes when it prints `0 failing`; exit 3 = did not build
